name: windy's nextbots (new custom gif nextbots!)
desc:
(Do you people really still play this?....)

A game inspired by gmod where you get chased by loud png's

Credits: nico's nextbots for most of the stuff. The rest of the credits are in the game's main menu.

I do not own the map. The map originally comes from nico's nextbots. (I was too lazy to make a map myself)

Press P or the panel button for custom nextbot creator panel (yes, this is a custom nextbot creator game similar to crazy's nextbots)

This game is still in beta! So expect some bugs and glitches at some point.

Note: the wind bux earnings are changed depending on how many nextbots there are so please do not beg others to remove or create nextbots just to grind wind bux. The wind bux is also only used to purchase bloxy colas for now.

Unfortunate note: this game is most likely discontinued due to my very little fascination with this quite, simple enough, project. It might still receive updates, just not big ones very often anymore. Sorry about that.
